integrity: Original analytic finite-dimensional spectral argument; standalone finite numerical checker is supporting evidence only. Earlier birth-death intertwining and semigroup-curvature principles are credited; priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Fixed m >= 2 with epsilon approaching zero; unit path transport cost, a single symmetric central slow rate; no uniform joint large-m/small-epsilon limit and no exact elementary peak formula at arbitrary epsilon.
title: Metastable Wasserstein amplification through a single slow bond
